newsitem.title: USA: Man arrested in stabbing death of wife, two daughters.
newsitem.headline: Man arrested in stabbing death of wife, two daughters.

text.p: Police were holding a 32-year-old man Monday for a brutal stabbing that left his wife and two of his daughters, aged three and six, dead.
William Maynor, 32, was arrested Sunday night after returning to his home near downtown Los Angeles with his four-year-old daughter, Melanie. She was unharmed.

The bodies of Maynor's wife, Monica, 31, and daughters Michelle, 3 and Megan, 6, had been found earlier in the day by Monica Maynor's mother, police said. The victims all suffered multiple stab wounds and were pronounced dead at the scene.

Police said the couple had been separated for several months and apparently an argument broke out Saturday at the home over whether Maynor could take another daughter, Melanie, on a trip. Witnesses told police they saw him leave Saturday but return shortly after midnight Sunday.

It was not until shortly before noon that the bodies were discoverd. Maynor returned to the scene Sunday evening but attempted to flee after he was spotted by neighbours, police said. Police gave chase and caught him.
